# Sequence numbers must strictly increase, and a repeated one is refused WITHOUT an
# acknowledgement - the single exception to acknowledge-first.
#
# An `ack` is keyed by sequence. Acknowledging a repeat would put two acknowledgements on
# the wire bearing the same key, and a reply that cannot be matched to a request is worse
# than a refusal.
#
# Captured from a real session against the host build, which is where the inconsistency
# between the implementation and an earlier draft of the specification was found.
CMD|1|hello|1
OBS|ack|1|hello
OBS|hello|1|c0x1|report
OBS|part|c0x1|probe|dev
OBS|part|c0x1|target|host
OBS|part|c0x1|transport|posix
OBS|done|1|ok||
# A repeat of a sequence already used.
CMD|1|hello|1
OBS|refused|1|bad-argument
# And one that is not a number at all.
CMD|banana|report
OBS|refused|0|bad-argument
CMD|2|bye
OBS|ack|2|bye
OBS|done|2|ok||
